Port AlderFenwick Hill41 Calder Row

Guide price · Freehold

$1,265,000

41 Calder Row, Fenwick Hill

    A 1934 brick house on one of Fenwick Hill's quieter rows, rebuilt inside in 2023 around the way light moves through it. The front rooms keep their parquet, picture rails and a deep bay; the back of the house opens to an 18-metre south garden through steel-framed folding doors.

    Upstairs, four bedrooms share a skylit landing, and the main bedroom runs the width of the garden side with its own shower room and dressing room. Air-source heat pump, 4.2 kW of solar and an EV charger on the drive.
